answer: Run surprise liveness checks: at a random moment each epoch the network sends a pulse to all agents at once, and each must return a fresh proof from its own model within two seconds, a nonce run through a prism of five random prompts. One operator hiding 100 clones on a single GPU must keep 100x the hardware hot to answer them all in time; the misses expose the farm, and its bond is slashed. An honest agent's cost is one cheap reply, so a real identity stays a pearl that is rare and hard to fake.
